description: This file defines the 'MacNodeModeCoordinator' class responsible for managing the lifecycle and connection logic of a macOS node in a distributed system. It handles starting and stopping the node, establishing WebSocket connections to a gateway, managing capabilities and permissions, and reacting to configuration changes.

classes.name: MacNodeModeCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the lifecycle and network connection for the macOS node, including reconnect logic, capability management, and interaction with gateway services.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the coordinator and begins the main run loop if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the current task and disconnects from the session.

methods.name: setPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway stable ID and disconnects the current session to allow reconnection with new preferences.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main asynchronous loop managing connection attempts, capabilities, permissions, and session lifecycle, with retry logic on failures.

methods.name: currentCaps
methods.description: Determines the current set of capabilities based on configuration and user defaults.

methods.name: currentPermissions
methods.description: Fetches the current permission statuses asynchronously.

methods.name: currentCommands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands supported based on current capabilities.

methods.name: buildSessionBox
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket session box configured for the provided URL if it uses the secure WebSocket protocol.
